requestedIntent: Bound guarded and full-BMAD patch loops by forcing REPLAN/SPLIT after two consecutive typed non-PASS review verdicts, without adding another review artifact or depending on prose wording.

docs: CHANGELOG.md#Run authorization and bounded review loops

limitations: The breaker considers only valid typed gates for the active story decided by code-review, test-review, or Process Judge actors; gate integrity remains the responsibility of the gate-verdict validator.
A PASS review resets the consecutive non-PASS sequence. The breaker does not infer severity labels or patch-growth heuristics.
The breaker applies only to guarded and full-BMAD typed runs.

evidence.note: Two consecutive REVISE/FAIL gates block; removing the second verdict returns the breaker to PASS.
